title: Talks with US won't happen while interim deal is breached, Iranian minister says
text:
Talks with US won't happen while interim deal is breached, Iranian minister says

Aug 9, 2026

Add AL-MONITOR on Google

FILE PHOTO: Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi attends a press conference alongside Iraqi Foreign Minister Fuad Hussein (not pictured), in Baghdad, Iraq, June 28, 2026. REUTERS/Thaier Al-Sudani/File Photo — Thaier Al-Sudani

DUBAI, Aug 9 (Reuters) - Iran and the U.S. are not engaged in talks and Tehran will not start them as long as Washington breaches an interim deal signed in June, Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said on Sunday, adding that messages are being exchanged via intermediaries. Araqchi repeated Iran's position that an agreement on the Strait of Hormuz between Tehran and Muscat was in the "final stages" but would not reopen the strategic waterway. In comments reported by Mehr news agency, he said the agreement would set out the new shipping lanes to be used once the U.S. fulfils other conditions and the strait is reopened to traffic. (Reporting by Dubai Newsroom; editing by Philippa Fletcher)
